claim: Singapore's NEA issued preventive measure notices (THPA) to 7 Indonesian companies on 16 Oct 2026 and to 3 more on 19 Oct 2026 (PT Buana Megatama Jaya, PT Mananjung Hayak, PT Baratama Putra Perkasa), 10 in total, confirmed by 5 outlets (NEA release itself not opened). Lines h1, h2, l4, l12, captions.

Per Singapore (Minister Grace Fu), investigations indicate some of the haze in Singapore came from fires on land of the 7 Indonesian companies (first batch); fines/legal action are being considered; no verdict. For the 3 later firms NEA cites 'indications' that smoke from fires on their concessions could have moved to Singapore. Lines l3, l5.

The notices require the companies to deploy firefighting personnel, stop/not start burning, and submit a plan to extinguish fires and prevent recurrence ('padamkan api, stop membakar, kirim rencana'). Line l5.

BNPB recorded 7.118 hotspots in 6 priority provinces as of 16 Oct 2026 (Kalteng 4.686, Sumsel 1.344, Kalsel 481, Kalbar 466, Jambi 137, Riau 4). Shown dated '16 Okt'. Not compared with SiPongi (different method: SiPongi high-confidence, 487 national / 172 in the 6 provinces on 19 Oct, Kemenhut 20 Oct). Line l1. On screen: only '7.118 titik panas · BNPB · per 16 Okt'; per-province figures are not shown (icons sized by province, names only).

4 people died fighting a forest fire in Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park (15 Oct 2026). Only '4 tewas' is said; no breakdown. Line l2. The fire began on farmland and spread into the park; not linked to any named company. No date on the card.

Former trade minister Muhammad Lutfi replied on Instagram (@m.lutfi; quoted by detik on 20 Oct 05:25 WIB, post time unconfirmed) to Singapore's warning to the first 7 firms ('yang Anda sebutkan'); per Lutfi, 4 of those 7 are SUPPLIERS (pemasok) to conglomerate groups whose holding companies/listings are in Singapore. The video never says the warned firms' own parent is in Singapore (hook: 'sebagian pemasok grup yang induknya justru di Singapura'). He also said Singapore should not write warning letters just to please its voters. Lines h2, l6, l7, l8, YT title ('Grup Induknya di Singapura'). Attributed to Lutfi; not verified by us. Grace Fu (via detik/Business Times) said Singapore had not found links to other customers or related companies.

On 19 Oct, K. Shanmugam said scrutiny would look beyond concession holders to the large corporate groups and persons who may ultimately control them. Script says 'Pada 19 Oktober' (same day as the Lutfi post per the coordinator/fact-check; the post's exact timestamp is not published). Line l9.

Two OTHER SGX-listed palm firms (not among the 10 NEA-notice recipients) dispute the fires' origin: First Resources (SGX statement 15 Oct) disputes that fires started on its plantations and says SOME began outside its concession and spread in ('sebagian api datang dari luar lahannya'); Kencana Agri (to SGX RegCo) says about 62 ha in its subsidiaries' concessions were affected and the fire spread from surrounding land ('apinya merembet dari lahan sekitar'). Kencana is separately under a preliminary Indonesian probe. On screen: Box A labelled '(bukan yang disurati NEA)'. Line l11, caption.

No public response found (as of 20-21 Oct searches) from the 10 Indonesian companies that received NEA notices; Bumitama Agri gave no statement to Mothership (requested a trading halt 16 Oct). Lines l12, caption.
Per Kapolri (Antara, 19 Oct), police are investigating (penyidikan) 98 corporate karhutla cases, including alleged ('dugaan') involvement of foreign parties. Line l13.

Mendagri Tito Karnavian (19 Oct): no objection to financial pressure from other countries as long as it is done under each country's legal system ('Sepanjang itu dilakukan dengan sistem hukum masing-masing, ya enggak masalah'); government will act firmly if corporations are involved. Line l14.

No company has been found guilty; matters are still being pursued ('masih diusut'): Singapore's notices are preventive and not a finding of legal liability (AP); in Indonesia the 98 corporate cases are in penyidikan and Bareskrim named 9 corporations as suspects (14-15 Oct), with no court ruling. Line l15; caption 'masih dalam proses hukum'.
